text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Satori onboarding this week. They hit a blocker: their demo pipeline will spike and they need (1) control-plane IP allowlist for staging, (2) temporary rate limit bump for token ingest, and (3) traffic routed to eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1 for lower latency. Can we approve/config this for a 10-hour window on Thurs UTC?

sam_support: Do we have the exact IPs and the requested RPS? Also is this for hosted API keys or Dedicated?

maria_cs: Hosted keys. Satori provided ranges and the demo schedule:
```
allowed_ips: ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.128/25"]
rate_limit: current 30 req/s -> request temporary 250 req/s (per-api-key aggregated)
regions: ["eu-west-1", "ap-southeast-1"]
window: 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z -> 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z
notes: staging environment only, control-plane endpoints only (no egress peering change)
```

emma_se: Thanks. Quick ask: can we do just control-plane ACL and RL increase, not touch customer routing for production? Also capture that they reported ~180ms latency from SG to us — routing to ap-southeast should help. This is a renewal upsell op; they'll likely move to Dedicated if the demo goes well.

jake_infra: I can implement ACL + rate bump. Need an internal change ticket and an owner for rollback if something noisy happens. Also prefer we scope to the control-plane hostname (api.redwood-inference.com) for their org id, not whole VPC.

maria_cs: Agreed. I'll keep it hostname-scoped. Can you create the change? I'll paste the short summary for the ticket and cc security for review.

maria_cs: Ticket payload to use (copy/paste):
```json
{
  "customer": "satori",
  "org_id": "org_00987",
  "scope": "control-plane hostname only",
  "allowed_ips": ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.128/25"],
  "rate_limit": {"from_rps": "30", "to_rps": "250"},
  "regions": ["eu-west-1","ap-southeast-1"],
  "window_utc": {"start": "2026-03-25T16:00:00Z","end": "2026-03-26T02:00:00Z"},
  "rollback_plan": "auto-revert at end of window + manual rollback if error rate > 2%",
  "contact": "maria_cs@satori.com"
}
```

sam_support: Can you also include logging hooks and token-level billing tags so we can track cost impact? We should capture time series for tokens/s and 95th latency during the window.

jake_infra: Yep. Will add logging tag `satori-demo-2026-03-25` and a temporary alert: error-rate > 1.5% or latency 95th > 600ms triggers rollback. Also will scope the ACL to the control-plane LB.

ops-bot: Change request created: CS-4821 (customer-success) and INF-9921 (infra). Assigned to jake_infra. ETA: change scheduled 2026-03-25T15:30Z for pre-checks.

maria_cs: @jake_infra thank you — please ping in this thread when pre-checks are done. I'll coordinate an enablement walkthrough + share a runbook with Satori before the demo.

emma_se: Small note for renewal tracking: flag Satori as "high-touch near-term" and log feedback about SG latency. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement session post-demo.

sam_support: After change completes, let's run a 30-min synthetic test from SG to confirm latency drop before the demo starts. Who will own that?

jake_infra: I'll run the synthetic from our ap-southeast probes at T-45 and post results here.

maria_cs: Awesome. If security needs anything extra, I'll loop them in. Thanks team :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INF-9921 -> change applied (staged) at 2026-03-25T15:35:12Z for validation.

jake_infra: Pre-checks done — ACLs applied to control-plane LB, rate limit policy staged in canary 10% traffic. No errors observed in canary for 15m. Proceeding to full window rollout at scheduled start.

emma_se: Marking this as renewal opportunity in CRM and capturing notes: "Demo support + latency fix; discuss Dedicated in follow-up."

maria_cs: Closing loop — Satori reported demo success and lower latency. We'll follow up with a joint post-mortem and renewal cadence. Thanks everyone :party-popper:
